The 2026 source explicitly warns its period may not be minimal, and gives no uniform composite-modulus sharpness. The result establishes sharpness for every composite modulus (and reproves already implicit prime cases), ruling out any coarser polynomial branch modulus by a uniform structural gap mechanism.
